# Twemoji

The 72×72 PNG emoji in this folder are [Twemoji](https://github.com/jdecked/twemoji) v17.0.3, copyright Twitter, Inc and other contributors, and Jason Sofonia & Justine De Caires and other contributors, licensed under [CC-BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) (full text in `LICENSE.txt`).
Changed from the original: files are renamed to drop `-fe0f` (U+FE0F) from their names. The images are unmodified.
